battle.name: 高句麗-東扶餘戰爭
battle.brief: 公元6年，高句麗在玄菟、樂浪邊境與東扶餘交兵，漢廷兩郡的邊防隨之戒嚴。史籍對此役只留數筆，只能由兩國的地理與制度推知走向：東扶餘倚玄菟郡內的城邑與農地，高句麗以五部之眾自鴨綠江上游南下。卡面這件羅馬短劍出自前1世紀的地中海，現場交手的實是漆弓、鐵矛與柄刀。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元6年前後高句麗與東扶餘在玄菟、樂浪邊境的一場直接衝突，參與者不止兩方。東扶餘是以夫餘城為中心、松花江中游立國的農業邦國，國土的基礎是灌溉稻作與漁鹽之利，兵眾以城邑民兵與弓箭步卒為主，騎兵極少；它在漢、晉兩朝多次向中原遣使，靠的是農產與地望而不是武力。漢朝一方由樂浪郡、玄菟郡、帶方郡的邊郡體系承擔，郡兵、屬國兵與邊地屯田戶構成實際的守備力量，指揮上歸屬幽州刺史部與遼東、玄菟兩位太守，度遼將軍與護羌校尉負責調度；漢廷在此役中未必是攻擊方，多半居於仲裁與追討的位置。高句麗一方的編制與漢式郡縣完全不同：全國分為中部、西部、南部、東部、北部五部，各部有首領與自己的兵眾，部眾的忠誠靠首領、婚姻與賞賜維繫；兵種以帶弓的步兵為主，兼有從北方遊牧地帶換來的少量騎兵，武器則大量取用經樂浪傳入的漢式鐵器。第三方壓力同樣存在：北方的匈奴與夫餘系部落在草原上與高句麗爭地，樂浪郡的漢式縣城、屯田與冶鐵業則是雙方都想控制的資源。總體而言，這是一場以邊郡城邑、屯田與山間通道為爭奪核心的地方性衝突，規模有限，影響卻綿長。
countriesEn: This war was a direct clash between Goguryeo and Dongyeo Buyeo on the Xuantu-Lelang frontier around the year 6 CE, and more than two parties were involved. Dongyeo Buyeo was an agricultural state centred on the city of Buyeo in the middle course of the Songhua river, its strength resting on irrigated rice cultivation and on fishing and salt rather than on arms; its fighting force consisted of the militia of its towns and of archers on foot, it had very few cavalry, and the reason it could keep sending envoys to the central plains through the Han and the Jin was the yield of its fields and its position, not its strength. The Han side was carried by the frontier commandery system of Lelang, Xuantu and Daiyang, with the commandery troops, the soldiers of the dependent states and the military-farm households making up the actual defence; in command the matter belonged to the Inspector of Youzhou and to the governors of Liaodong and Xuantu, with the General of the Du Liao and the Inspector of the Qiang responsible for the movement of troops, so that in this war the Han was not necessarily the aggressor but more often the arbiter and the pursuer. The organisation of Goguryeo was entirely different from that of a Chinese commandery: the country was divided into five divisions, the middle, the west, the south, the east and the north, each with its own leaders and its own men, the loyalty of those men held together by the chiefs, by marriages and by the distribution of rewards; the bulk of the army was infantry armed with the bow, with a small amount of cavalry taken or bartered from the northern steppe, and its weapons were largely Han ironwork that reached the country through Lelang. Third-party pressure was present as well: in the north the Xiongnu and the Buyeo-line groups competed with Goguryeo for grazing land, while the Han-style county towns, the military farms and the iron industry of Lelang were resources that both sides wanted to control. In the whole, this was a local conflict fought over frontier commandery seats, military farms and mountain tracks, limited in scale but long in its consequences.
people: 正史留下的名字多屬漢廷一方，高句麗早期首領與東扶餘君主的名諱在傳世文獻中大半失傳，這本身就是這場戰爭記載稀薄的註腳。漢廷方面，先是樂浪、玄菟一線的太守與校尉：公元56年中元元年，漢廷以樂浪、玄菟、帶方、句注等六郡兵與屬國夷兵討高句麗，斬首二千餘級，這是先秦兩漢以來東北亞最大規模的一次郡兵出擊；公元105年建光元年，玄菟太守張敞擊破高句麗於沸流水，乘勝追至卑沙城，焚其宮室而還；同年遼東方向追擊失利，士卒多為高句麗所伏，說明漢軍追擊的極限在哪裡；公元109年永初三年，遼東太守龐奮再攻高句麗，斬首二千餘級。屬國首領之中，扶餘系的渠帥與濊貊系的屯長也常被帶入戰報，漢廷正是靠這些「屬國都尉」把邊外的部眾編進自己的兵序列。東扶餘一方的國王在《三國史記》與《後漢書》裡多以「扶餘王」稱之，能確認的特點是：他們是那些向漢廷求援、與樂浪郡保持使節往來的首領，其安全與土地往往寄望於漢廷的處置。高句麗方面，五部首領早期不見於史冊，較早留下名字的如西漢元帝時的浿水侯卑，以及公元3世紀五部分立時的尚、璜、騰等名號；到公元5世紀，高句麗王已能遣使北魏，與樂浪、玄菟周旋，而5世紀末攻破扶餘的決策，也出自部族首領之間的合議。真正決定後續走向的，還有公元668年扶餘王子泉男生降唐，以及公元694年大祚榮率扶餘遺民起兵建國這兩個人。
peopleEn: The names the official histories preserve belong mostly to the Han side; the personal names of the early Goguryeo chiefs and of the Dongyeo Buyeo kings were largely lost in transmission, and that fact is itself the best commentary on how thin the record of this war is. On the Han side there were first of all the governors and the commandants of the Lelang-Xuantu line: in the first year of Zhongyuan, 56 CE, the court marched against Goguryeo with the troops of six commanderies including Lelang, Xuantu, Daiyang and Juzhu, together with the soldiers of the dependent states, and cut off more than two thousand heads, the largest single deployment of commandery troops in northeast Asia in the whole Qin-Han period; in the first year of Jianguang, 105 CE, the governor of Xuantu, Zhang Chang, beat Goguryeo at Feiliu, pursued them as far as the city of Bisha, burned their palace and withdrew; in the same year the pursuit from the Liaodong direction failed and its soldiers were ambushed, which shows exactly where the reach of the Han army ended; in the third year of Yongchu, 109 CE, the governor of Liaodong, Pang Fen, attacked Goguryeo again and cut off more than two thousand heads. Among the dependent states the chiefs of the Buyeo line and the village leaders of the Mohei line were often named in the reports, and it was through offices such as the commandant of a dependent state that the court folded the peoples beyond the frontier into its own order of battle. The kings of Dongyeo Buyeo are mostly given simply as the king of Buyeo in the Samguk Sagi and the Hou Hanshu, and what can be confirmed about them is this: they were the leaders who appealed to the Han for help and kept up embassies with the governor of Lelang, their safety and their land hanging in practice on how the court chose to handle them. On the Goguryeo side the chiefs of the five divisions do not appear in the histories at all in the early period; among the earliest names that survive are Bohai of the Xunshui marquisate under Emperor Yuan of the Western Han, and the names Shang, Huang and Teng of the third century, when the country had split into five divisions. By the fifth century the king of Goguryeo could already send envoys to Northern Wei and hold his own negotiations with Lelang and Xuantu, and the decision to break Buyeo at the end of that century was taken by a council of the tribal chiefs. What really settled the later course were two men: the Buyeo prince Quan Nansheng, who surrendered to Tang in 668, and Da Zuo Rong, who led the Buyeo people in revolt and founded a state in 694.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬短劍是前1世紀地中海世界的軍團標準佩劍：鍛造的短刃配圓盤形護手，設計上完全針對近身格鬥，短兵相接靠的是盾牌的邊緣與刺突的節奏，而不是揮砍。這種兵器與公元6年東北亞的戰場毫無關係——中原的環首刀要到東漢前後才傳入東北亞，羅馬的短劍連安息都未曾東傳——因此它在本卡中只能作為對照，提醒讀者：戰爭列表的兵器欄位並不等於戰場所用的裝備。本役真正出現的器具有這樣一套：高句麗與東扶餘的兵卒以漆弓配木石箭桿為主要射程武器，鐵矛、鐵戈與柄刀用於近身，柄刀沿用漢式環首刀的形式，多半由樂浪郡的冶鐵作坊供應；防護以皮甲、木札甲為主，輔以圓盾與長柄大盾。攻城器械相當簡陋，只有楯車、木柵與繩梯，糧食靠牛車與人力背負，越過鴨綠江與松花江的支流時更依賴結冰期與春汛前的淺灘。樂浪郡境內有冶鐵遺址與鐵器作坊，漢朝邊郡以屯田供給軍糧，並以官營牧苑與馬市維持邊軍的騎兵數量；漁獲、鹽與木材是東扶餘的關鍵物資。雙方的舟師使用漢式平底船，沿大同江與鴨綠江轉運兵員與糧秣，冬季結冰時則改走陸路冰面。
kitsEn: The gladius on the card was the standard side-arm of the Roman legion of the first century BC: a forged short blade with a disc-shaped guard, designed entirely for close fighting, where the rhythm of the shield and the thrust of the sword mattered rather than any swing. Such a weapon had nothing to do with a battlefield in northeast Asia in the year 6 CE - the ring-pommel sabre of the central plains only reached northeast Asia around the Eastern Han, and the Roman short sword never travelled as far as Parthia - so on this card it can serve only as a comparison, a reminder that the weapon field of a war list is not the same thing as the equipment on the field. The kit that was actually present in this campaign was as follows. The soldiers of Goguryeo and of Dongyeo Buyeo used lacquered bows with wooden shafts and stone or bone heads as their main ranged weapons, with iron spears, iron halberds and single-edged knives for close work; the knives followed the Han ring-pommel form and were largely supplied by the iron workshops of Lelang commandery. Protection was leather armour and wooden lamellar armour, helped by round shields and large shields of the long-shield type. The siege equipment was rudimentary, nothing beyond mantlets, wooden palisades and rope ladders; grain moved on ox carts and on the backs of men, and the crossing of the branches of the Yalu and the Songhua depended on the freezing season and on the shallows before the spring floods. Iron-smelting remains and iron workshops existed inside Lelang commandery, the Han frontier commanderies fed their garrisons from military farms, and state pastures and horse markets were used to keep the numbers of cavalry in the frontier army; fish, salt and timber were the critical materials of Dongyeo Buyeo. The boat sections of both sides used flat-bottomed Han-style craft to move men and grain along the Taedong and the Yalu, and in the winter freeze they went over the ice on land instead.
tactics: 高句麗方面的戰術可以用一句話概括：避開正面攻城，以小隊襲擾邊郡，奪糧而退。這個模式在公元6年及其後的漢邊郡記載裡反覆出現——高句麗五部各出部分兵眾，沿鴨綠江上游與玄菟郡境內的山間通道南下，選擇郡兵守備空隙或冬季糧秣儲備不足的城邑夜間突入，縱火破壞倉城，擄走人口與工匠後立即退回山地；官方文書把這種行動記作「寇邊」，漢軍則被迫每年出兵追討。追擊本身是漢軍最脆弱的環節：地形是山地與雪原，燃料與乾糧有限，一旦深入就容易被伏擊，公元105年遼東方向的失利即為明證。守城方的東扶餘與漢邊郡採用相反的邏輯——依靠土築城垣、木柵與護城壕溝固守城邑，以密集箭雨壓制進攻者，等敵軍糧盡或天寒再行反擊或驅逐。漢廷的部署是典型的邊郡體系：郡兵駐守郡治與縣城，烽燧候官沿邊傳遞警報，屯田戶就地供糧，遇警則由度遼將軍、護羌校尉調度樂浪、玄菟、帶方各郡的兵員；船隊沿海路與河道運糧，避免陸路在冬季斷絕。雙方都把不讓對方得到農業與人口當成目標，因此掠奪的收穫往往是糧食、牲畜與俘虜，而不是城池本身。
tacticsEn: The tactics of Goguryeo can be put in a single phrase: avoid pitched assaults on the walls, harass the frontier commanderies with small columns, take the grain and withdraw. The pattern recurs again and again in the Han frontier records from the year 6 onwards and after it. The five divisions of Goguryeo each sent out part of their strength along the upper Yalu and along the mountain tracks inside Xuantu commandery, chose a county seat where the garrison was thin or where the stores of grain were short in winter, broke in by night, set fire to the granaries, carried off people and craftsmen, and fell back into the hills at once; the official documents call this raiding the border, and the Han army was obliged to send troops out in pursuit every year. The pursuit was the weakest link in the Han operation: the country is hill and snowfield, fuel and dry rations are limited, and a force that goes deep can easily be ambushed, as the failure on the Liaodong side in 105 CE shows. Dongyeo Buyeo and the Han frontier commanderies used the opposite logic, relying on rammed-earth walls, wooden palisades and moats to hold the towns, answering the attacker with dense arrow-flights and waiting until the enemy's grain ran out or the cold broke before counter-attacking or driving it off. The Han deployment was the standard frontier pattern: commandery troops garrisoned the commandery seats and the county towns, beacon and watch-officers passed the alarm along the frontier, military-farm households supplied grain on the spot, and when the alarm was raised the General of the Du Liao and the Inspector of the Qiang moved the troops of Lelang, Xuantu and Daiyang; boat sections carried grain by the coastal route and the rivers so that the land road would not be cut in winter. Both sides treated denying the other agriculture and population as the object, so the prize of a raid was grain, cattle and captives rather than the town itself.
data: 這一場戰爭的具體數字，傳世文獻保存下來的極少，可以確定的只有以下幾組。其一，參戰體系：漢廷在東北亞設樂浪、玄菟、帶方三郡，《漢書·地理志》所載樂浪郡戶約六萬餘、口約二十五萬餘，玄菟郡戶四萬餘、口十五萬餘，可見邊郡的常備兵源與丁口規模；玄菟、樂浪兩郡屬國的部落首領各領部眾，漢廷以屬國都尉的編制把他們編進漢軍序列。其二，漢軍討高句麗的戰果有兩條可查的記載：公元56年以六郡兵及夷兵出擊，斬首二千餘級；公元109年遼東太守龐奮再出，斬首二千餘級；公元105年玄菟太守張敞破高句麗於沸流水，追至卑沙城焚其宮室而還，未記斬首之數。其三，地理尺度：樂浪郡治在今平壤一帶，玄菟郡治在遼東塞外、與高句麗五部犬牙交錯，郡治與高句麗核心區的距離在數百里上下，騎兵一日可達，步兵行軍則需數日；鴨綠江與松花江之間的通道是雙方往來的瓶頸。其四，時間：兵事多在秋冬與早春，糧草由海路與屯田供給，冬季一旦積雪封山，追擊即止。卡面標出的公元6年與四月，是這一類邊郡衝突的常見起算點，但史籍未留下確切的出師月份，具體日期無從考證，寫下來的四月只是依當地春汛前渡河的習慣所標。
dataEn: Of the figures belonging to this war, very few have survived in the transmitted literature, and only the following groups can be stated with confidence. First, the size of the participating systems: the Han maintained three commanderies in northeast Asia, Lelang, Xuantu and Daiyang; the Hanshu treatise on the geography records Lelang with somewhat more than sixty thousand households and rather more than two hundred and fifty thousand people, and Xuantu with more than forty thousand households and over a hundred and fifty thousand people, which indicates the pool of manpower and of registered households from which the frontier garrisons drew; the tribal chiefs of the dependent states of Xuantu and Lelang each led their own men, and the court folded them into its order of battle through the office of the commandant of a dependent state. Second, two sets of results are on record for Han campaigns against Goguryeo: in 56 CE the expedition of the six commanderies with the dependent-state soldiers cut off more than two thousand heads, and in 109 CE the governor of Liaodong, Pang Fen, cut off more than two thousand heads again; in 105 CE the governor of Xuantu, Zhang Chang, beat Goguryeo at Feiliu, pursued it to the city of Bisha, burned its palace and returned, and no count of heads is given. Third, the geographical scale: the seat of Lelang commandery lay about Pyongyang, the seat of Xuantu lay beyond the Liaodong frontier and interlocked with the five divisions of Goguryeo, and the distance from those seats to the Goguryeo core lay on the order of several hundred li, a day's ride for cavalry but several days of marching for infantry; the corridor between the Yalu and the Songhua was the bottleneck of movement for both sides. Fourth, timing: the campaigning took place mostly in late autumn, winter and early spring, with grain supplied by the sea route and by the military farms, and once the winter snow closed the passes the pursuit stopped. The year 6 and the fourth month given on the card are the usual starting point for this class of frontier clash, but the histories preserve no exact month of departure and the precise date cannot be established; the fourth month is marked only in accordance with the local habit of fording the rivers before the spring floods.
cause: 開戰的根由，史料沒有留下單一的說法，但可以從三條線索拼出來。第一條是土地：東扶餘控制松花江中游的沖積平原，這裡的土壤、灌溉與漁鹽是整個東北亞最穩定的農業剩餘；高句麗五部的生計原本更依賴鴨綠江上游的漁獵與小規模耕作，人口的增加逼著他們向南尋找可耕之地，扶餘的平原因此成了唯一的目標。第二條是通道：漢朝的樂浪郡像一枚楔子插在鴨綠江與圖們江之間，切斷了高句麗與扶餘之間的陸路聯繫；高句麗若不拿下或繞開這枚楔子，就無法把勢力伸向北方草原，而東扶餘的存在，恰恰是漢朝得以長期控制鴨綠江以南的屏障。第三條是牧場與馬：北方遊牧地帶的牲畜與馬匹是五部組建騎兵的前提，匈奴在北方的壓力又使高句麗必須搶在別人之前取得立足點。於是，公元6年這類邊境衝突的表層理由往往是掠奪——破城、奪糧、擄人，都是可以寫進戰報的實績；深層的理由卻是生存與擴張。至於東扶餘為何守得住，取決於漢朝是否願意出兵，而漢朝每次都願意，因為樂浪與玄菟一旦失守，匈奴與高句麗就會連成一線，邊郡的體系也會從此崩解。
causeEn: The sources preserve no single account of why the war began, but the reasons can be assembled from three lines of evidence. The first is land. Dongyeo Buyeo held the alluvial plain of the middle Songhua, whose soil, irrigation and fishing and salt provided the most reliable agricultural surplus in all of northeast Asia; the livelihood of the five divisions of Goguryeo had rested more on hunting and fishing in the upper Yalu and on small-scale cultivation, and as the population grew they were pushed south in search of land that could be ploughed, which made the Buyeo plain the one obvious target. The second is the corridor. Lelang commandery stood in the neck of the land between the Yalu and the Tumen like a wedge, cutting the land route between Goguryeo and Buyeo; unless it took that wedge or went around it, Goguryeo could not extend its power towards the northern steppe, and the very existence of Dongyeo Buyeo was what allowed the Han to hold the country south of the Yalu for so long. The third is pasture and horses: the livestock and horses of the northern steppe were the precondition for the divisions to build up cavalry, and the pressure of the Xiongnu in the north meant Goguryeo had to seize its foothold before someone else did. The surface reason for a border clash of the year 6 was therefore usually plunder - breaking towns, seizing grain, carrying off people, all of them results that could be written into a report - while the deeper reason was survival and expansion. As for why Dongyeo Buyeo could hold on, that depended on whether the Han court was willing to send troops out, and the court was willing every time, because if Lelang and Xuantu fell the Xiongnu and Goguryeo would link up into a single line and the whole commandery system of the frontier would come apart.
impact: 這場邊境衝突的後果，要放到很長的時間裡才看得清楚。就眼前而言，高句麗沒有打下樂浪與玄菟兩處郡治，漢朝對鴨綠江以南的直轄維持了四百餘年，直到公元4世紀高句麗才真正攻破樂浪，漢末的郡縣體系才被北方民族政權取代。就長遠而言，這些年年復一年的襲擾與追討，把高句麗的軍隊長期鍛造成一支熟悉東北亞山地、冬季嚴寒與河道運輸的軍隊；五部之間在戰爭中反覆形成的聯盟與婚姻網，日後成為高句麗統合東北亞的組織基礎。人口與技術的流動同樣重要：被擄走的樂浪、玄菟百姓與匠人進入東北亞各地，把漢式冶鐵、築城、馬政與稻作技術帶往鴨綠江以北，考古上在東北亞廣泛出土的漢式鐵器與農具，正是這段過程的痕跡。文化層面上，扶餘、高句麗、濊貊、漢四方的往來，造就了高句麗自身獨特的制度與信仰面貌，佛教與儒學的傳入、禪僧與方士的往來，都以這些邊境通道為媒介。戰後數百年間，扶餘舊地最終變成兩個新國家：668年隨高句麗一起被唐軍平定的東扶餘，與694年大祚榮以扶餘遺民建立的渤海國；後者在一個多世紀裡成為東北亞僅次於唐與日本的強權，遣使與通交遍及倭、韓、靺鞨。
impactEn: The consequences of this border conflict only become clear over a very long span. In the short run, Goguryeo did not take the commandery seats of Lelang and Xuantu, and the Han ruled directly south of the Yalu for more than four hundred years, until in the fourth century Goguryeo really did break Lelang and the late Han commandery system was replaced by a regime of the northern peoples. In the longer run, these annual raids and pursuits made the Goguryeo army, year after year, a force thoroughly at home in the mountains, the severe winters and the river transport of northeast Asia; and the alliances and marriage network that formed again and again among the five divisions in the course of these wars became the organisational basis on which Goguryeo later unified northeast Asia. The movement of people and of techniques mattered just as much: the Lelang and Xuantu villagers and craftsmen who were carried off entered the communities of northeast Asia and carried Han-style smelting, fortification, horse administration and rice cultivation north of the Yalu, and the Han-style iron tools and implements that archaeology finds in such quantity across northeast Asia are the traces of exactly that process. At the level of culture, the intercourse of Buyeo, Goguryeo, Mohei and Han produced the distinctive institutions and beliefs of Goguryeo itself; the spread of Buddhism and of Confucian learning, and the travel of monks and of alchemists, all ran through these frontier corridors. Over the centuries after the war, the old Buyeo land became two new states: Dongyeo Buyeo, which was put down together with Goguryeo by the Tang army in 668, and the kingdom of Balhae, founded in 694 by Da Zuo Rong from the Buyeo people; for more than a century the latter was the strongest power in northeast Asia after Tang and Japan itself, sending missions and opening exchanges as far as the Japanese archipelago, the Korean states and the Jurchen lands.
result: 就公元6年這一役本身而言，能確定的結果是：衝突沒有演變成高句麗與東扶餘之間的決戰，漢朝的樂浪、玄菟邊郡守住了，東扶餘也沒有被消滅，雙方在鴨綠江與松花江之間的邊界上又對峙了很長一段時間。真正能稱為結果的，是這場衝突把雙方的力量結構固定下來：高句麗沒有得到扶餘的平原與人口，東扶餘沒有得到高句麗的戰力與北方通道，漢朝則以郡兵、屯田和烽燧的邊防體系，把鴨綠江以南變成一道常設的界線，延續了四百餘年。真正的勝負要到公元5世紀末才見分曉：高句麗終於攻破扶餘，扶餘王奔漢，遺民被安置在玄菟郡屬國之下，扶餘作為獨立政權的歷史自此告終，其餘眾則成為高句麗王國的一部分。公元668年，唐軍平定高句麗與東扶餘，扶餘人泉男生降唐；694年大祚榮率扶餘遺民起兵，建立渤海國，把這段被壓迫而生的族群記憶帶進了東北亞政治的另一個階段。換句話說，公元6年的衝突本身沒有戰功可述，它真正的結果是把高句麗與東扶餘這組對手與資源之間的關係，固定成了一條貫穿後世三個世紀的線，直到渤海國出現才被徹底改寫。
resultEn: For the year 6 itself the outcome that can be established is this: the clash did not turn into a decisive battle between Goguryeo and Dongyeo Buyeo; the Han frontier commanderies of Lelang and Xuantu held; Dongyeo Buyeo was not destroyed; and the two sides went on facing each other across the boundary between the Yalu and the Songhua for a long time. What can properly be called the result is that the conflict fixed the balance of power between them: Goguryeo did not get the plain and the people of Buyeo, Dongyeo Buyeo did not get Goguryeo's war-making power or the road to the north, and the Han, with its commandery troops, its military farms and its beacon system, turned the country south of the Yalu into a standing frontier that lasted for more than four hundred years. The real decision was not reached until the end of the fifth century: Goguryeo finally broke Buyeo, the king of Buyeo fled to the Han, the remaining people were settled under the dependent states of Xuantu commandery, and the independent history of Buyeo came to an end, its population being absorbed into the kingdom of Goguryeo. In 668 the Tang army put down both Goguryeo and Dongyeo Buyeo, and the Buyeo prince Quan Nansheng surrendered; in 694 Da Zuo Rong led the Buyeo people in revolt and founded the kingdom of Balhae, carrying the ethnic memory born of this oppression into another phase of northeast Asian politics. In other words, the clash of the year 6 has no battle honours to record; its real result was to fix the relationship between these two rivals and their resources as a line running through the three centuries that followed, a line that was only rewritten when Balhae appeared.
